responsibility: Contains the main implementation of the MicroBlaze GCC backend. It owns target-specific RTL expansion and lowering, address and symbol classification, frame and calling-convention logic, section/small-data handling, PIC/TLS support, operand printing, cost and scheduling decisions, trampolines and thunks, exception-return handling, and post-reload or machine-dependent reorganization such as prefetch insertion, and it binds these routines into GCC through the MicroBlaze TARGET_* hook definitions and targetm initializer.
same_name_distinction: This is the executable C++ backend implementation file for MicroBlaze: it defines the target-side algorithms and state, then binds them into GCC via TARGET_* hooks and targetm. Unlike microblaze.h it does not provide the compile-time macro/spec description, unlike microblaze.md it does not declare RTL insn patterns and automata, and unlike microblaze.opt it does not declare command-line options.
